title: A. O. Smith Recalls 30-Gallon Gas Water Heaters Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Lowe's
summary: The water heater's flame arrestor can fail to work properly, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 190.

title: A. O. Smith Recalls Ultra-Low NOx Water Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The water heater's gas burner screen develops tears. The water heater's burner can then create excess radiant heat, posing a fire hazard if the water heater is installed directly on a wood or other combustible floor. Units: About 616,000.

title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
summary: An incorrectly installed throttle body can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 56,000.

title: H.I.S. Recalls Girl's Clothing Sets Due to Violation of Federal Lead Content Ban
summary: The metal pendant on the necklace contains levels of lead that exceed the federal lead content ban. Lead is toxic if ingested by young children and can cause adverse health issues. Units: About 4,400.

title: Lifetone Technology Recalls Bedside Fire Alarm and Clocks Due to Failure to Fully Alert Consumers to a Fire
summary: The bedside fire alarm and clock can fail to operate and fully alert consumers to a fire. Units: About 10,000.

title: Mountain Warehouse Recalls Children's Water Bottles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The water bottle's spout can detach, exposing a small ring, posing a choking hazard to children. Units: About 1,000.

title: Kubota Recalls Mowers and Compact Tractors Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Hot coolant can spray out onto consumers from the overheated and pressurized coolant reservoir tank, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 121,100.

title: Black & Decker Recalls Hammer Drills Due to Injury Hazard
summary: The side handle sold with the drill can slip or break, leading to a loss of control of the tool, posing an injury hazard Units: About 641,000 (in addition, about 18,000 were sold in Canada).

title: MCS Industries Recalls Glacier Bay Medicine Cabinets Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at The Home Depot
summary: The mirror can detach from the medicine cabinet door, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 15,400.

title: Pain Relief Naturally Recalls Pain and Itch Relief Creams, Sprays and Gels Due to Failure to Meet Child Resistant Closure Requirement; Risk of Poisoning (Recall Alert)
summary: The packaging is not child resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. The pain and itch relief creams, sprays and gels contain lidocaine, posing a risk of poisoning to young children if they put it on their skin or ingest it. Units: About 7,000.

title: HoMedics Recalls Nightlights Due to Choking Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The small feet on the giraffe-shaped nightlight can detach, posing a choking hazard to small children. Units: About 3,000.

title: Seabreeze International Recalls Bathroom Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The safety cutoff can fail to function allowing the heater to rapidly overheat, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,100 (in addition, about 3,050 were sold in Canada).

title: LÍLLÉbaby Recalls Baby Carriers Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The sliding chest-clip strap can detach from the shoulder strap, posing a fall hazard to the child in the carrier. Units: About 6,600.

title: RH Recalls Metal-Wrapped Coffee Tables Due to Risk of Lead Exposure (Recall Alert)
summary: The tables' metal top can contain lead and presents a risk of lead exposure to children. Lead is toxic if ingested and can cause adverse health effects. Units: 1524.

title: YTL International Recalls Log Splitters Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The log splitter's welding on the tongue box assembly can crack and cause the log splitter tank to disconnect from the rest of unit, posing an injury hazard. Units: About 1,460.

title: IKEA Recalls Dining Tables Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The table's glass extension leaf can detach and fall unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 8,200 (in addition, about 1,500 were sold in Canada).

title: Lumber Liquidators Recalls 5-Gallon Buckets Due to Drowning Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Young children can fall into buckets and drown. The buckets do not have the required cautionary label warning of the drowning risk posed to young children. Units: About 22,700.

title: Öhlins Recalls Bicycle Forks Sold on Specialized Bicycles Due to Fall and Injury Hazards
summary: The air cartridge can abruptly spring out of the stanchion tube, posing fall and injury risks to the rider. Units: About 5,400 (In addition, about 550 were sold in Canada).
